descriptions.cn: 用于在紧凑空间中组织信息的可折叠内容面板
descriptions.en: A collapsible content panel for organizing information in a compact space

descriptions.cn: 向用户展示重要消息与通知，并提供状态指示
descriptions.en: Display important messages and notifications to users with status indicators

descriptions.cn: 用于关键确认操作的模态对话框，需要用户关注并明确操作
descriptions.en: Modal dialog for critical confirmations requiring user attention and explicit action

descriptions.cn: 结合选择与过滤，让用户从选项列表中搜索并选择
descriptions.en: An autocomplete combines a select with filtering, allowing users to search and select from a list of options

descriptions.cn: 显示用户头像，支持自定义 fallback 内容
descriptions.en: Display user profile images with customizable fallback content

descriptions.cn: 以叠放或网格展示多个头像，并支持溢出计数
descriptions.en: Display a stacked or grid group of avatars with overflow counting

descriptions.cn: 相对其他元素定位的小型指示器，常用于通知数量、状态点与标签
descriptions.en: Displays a small indicator positioned relative to another element, commonly used for notification counts, status dots, and labels

descriptions.cn: 导航面包屑，显示当前页面在层级结构中的位置
descriptions.en: Navigation breadcrumbs showing the current page's location within a hierarchy

descriptions.cn: 可点击的按钮组件，支持多种变体与状态
descriptions.en: A clickable button component with multiple variants and states

descriptions.cn: 将相关按钮组合在一起，保持一致的样式与间距
descriptions.en: Group related buttons together with consistent styling and spacing

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria Calendar 的可组合日期选择器，支持月网格、导航与年份选择
descriptions.en: Composable date picker with month grid, navigation, and year picker support built on React Aria Calendar

descriptions.cn: 上游进行中；通过 Calendar 公开部件组合使用。年份面板关闭后的键盘焦点恢复存在已知限制，尚未完成稳定性和全部状态验收。
descriptions.en: Upstream work in progress; compose through Calendar public parts. Keyboard focus restoration after closing the year panel has a known limitation. Stability and full-state acceptance are still pending.

descriptions.cn: 灵活容器组件，用于分组相关内容与操作
descriptions.en: Flexible container component for grouping related content and actions

descriptions.cn: 复选框允许用户从列表中选择多项，或标记单个项目为选中状态
descriptions.en: Checkboxes allow users to select multiple items from a list of individual items, or to mark one individual item as selected.

descriptions.cn: 用于管理多个复选框选择的复选框组组件
descriptions.en: A checkbox group component for managing multiple checkbox selections

descriptions.cn: 用于显示标签、状态与分类的小型信息徽章
descriptions.en: Small informational badges for displaying labels, statuses, and categories

descriptions.cn: 用于关闭对话框、模态框或 dismiss 内容的按钮组件
descriptions.en: Button component for closing dialogs, modals, or dismissing content

descriptions.cn: 二维颜色选择器，允许用户从渐变区域中选择颜色
descriptions.en: A 2D color picker that allows users to select colors from a gradient area

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria ColorField 的颜色输入字段，支持标签、描述与验证
descriptions.en: Color input field with labels, descriptions, and validation built on React Aria ColorField

descriptions.cn: 可组合的颜色选择器，在多个颜色组件间同步颜色值
descriptions.en: A composable color picker that synchronizes color value between multiple color components

descriptions.cn: 颜色滑块允许用户调整颜色值的单个通道
descriptions.en: A color slider allows users to adjust an individual channel of a color value

descriptions.cn: 颜色值的视觉预览，并提供无障碍支持
descriptions.en: A visual preview of a color value with accessibility support

descriptions.cn: 允许用户从预置调色板中选择颜色的 swatch 列表
descriptions.en: A list of color swatches that allows users to select a color from a predefined palette.

descriptions.cn: 将文本输入与 ListBox 结合，用户可通过输入查询把选项列表过滤为匹配项
descriptions.en: A combo box combines a text input with a listbox, allowing users to filter a list of options to items matching a query

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria DateField 的日期输入字段，包含标签、说明与校验
descriptions.en: Date input field with labels, descriptions, and validation built on React Aria DateField

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria DatePicker，通过 DateField 与 Calendar 组合的可组合日期选择器
descriptions.en: Composable date picker built on React Aria DatePicker with DateField and Calendar composition

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria DateRangePicker，通过 DateField 与 RangeCalendar 组合的可组合日期范围选择器
descriptions.en: Composable date range picker built on React Aria DateRangePicker with DateField and RangeCalendar composition

descriptions.cn: 为表单字段及其他组件提供补充说明文本
descriptions.en: Provides supplementary text for form fields and other components

descriptions.cn: 可折叠区块，包含标题、触发按钮与内容面板
descriptions.en: A disclosure is a collapsible section with a header containing a heading and a trigger button, and a panel that wraps the content.

descriptions.cn: 管理多个 Disclosure 项展开状态的容器
descriptions.en: Container that manages multiple Disclosure items with coordinated expanded states

descriptions.cn: 用于补充内容与操作的滑出面板
descriptions.en: Slide-out panel for supplementary content and actions

descriptions.cn: 展示用户可选择的操作或选项列表
descriptions.en: A dropdown displays a list of actions or options that a user can choose

descriptions.cn: 用于展示错误的底层错误消息组件
descriptions.en: A low-level error message component for displaying errors

descriptions.cn: 展示表单字段校验错误消息
descriptions.en: Displays validation error messages for form fields

descriptions.cn: 将相关表单控件与图例、描述和操作组合在一起
descriptions.en: Group related form controls with legends, descriptions, and actions

descriptions.cn: 用于表单校验与提交处理的包裹组件
descriptions.en: Wrapper component for form validation and submission handling

descriptions.cn: 接受标准 HTML 属性的原生单行文本输入组件
descriptions.en: Primitive single-line text input component that accepts standard HTML attributes

descriptions.cn: 将相关输入控件与前后缀元素组合，以增强表单字段
descriptions.en: Group related input controls with prefix and suffix elements for enhanced form fields

descriptions.cn: 用于验证码与安全认证的一次性密码输入组件
descriptions.en: A one-time password input component for verification codes and secure authentication

descriptions.cn: 展示键盘快捷键与按键组合
descriptions.en: Display keyboard shortcuts and key combinations

descriptions.cn: 渲染与表单控件关联的无障碍标签。
descriptions.en: Renders an accessible label associated with form controls

descriptions.cn: 用于导航的样式化锚点组件，内置图标支持。
descriptions.en: A styled anchor component for navigation with built-in icon support

descriptions.cn: 列表框展示一组选项，并允许用户选择一个或多个。
descriptions.en: A listbox displays a list of options and allows a user to select one or more of them

descriptions.cn: 独立菜单的本地状态复查：普通项、单选、多选、禁用、危险项和页内操作反馈；预览可用不代表全状态验收。
descriptions.en: Local standalone menu review: actions, single and multiple selection, disabled and danger items. Preview availability is not full-state acceptance.

descriptions.cn: Meter 表示已知范围内的数量，或一个比例值。
descriptions.en: A meter represents a quantity within a known range, or a fractional value.

descriptions.cn: 用于聚焦用户交互与重要内容的对话框遮罩层。
descriptions.en: Dialog overlay for focused user interactions and important content

descriptions.cn: 数字输入字段，包含增减按钮、校验与国际化格式化能力。
descriptions.en: Number input fields with increment/decrement buttons, validation, and internationalized formatting

descriptions.cn: 分页导航：可组合的页码链接、上一页/下一页按钮与省略号指示器。
descriptions.en: Page navigation with composable page links, previous/next buttons, and ellipsis indicators

descriptions.cn: 在由按钮或任意自定义元素触发后，于 portal 中展示丰富内容。
descriptions.en: Displays rich content in a portal triggered by a button or any custom element

descriptions.cn: 进度条用于展示某项操作随时间变化的确定或不确定进度。
descriptions.en: A progress bar shows either determinate or indeterminate progress of an operation over time.

descriptions.cn: 环形进度指示器，用于展示确定或不确定的进度。
descriptions.en: A circular progress indicator that shows determinate or indeterminate progress.

descriptions.cn: 用于从列表中选择单个选项的单选组。
descriptions.en: Radio group for selecting a single option from a list

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria RangeCalendar 的可组合日期范围选择器，包含月份网格、导航与年份选择支持。
descriptions.en: Composable date range picker with month grid, navigation, and year picker support built on React Aria RangeCalendar

descriptions.cn: 通过阴影提示可滚动溢出内容，并根据滚动位置自动检测显示或隐藏。
descriptions.en: Apply visual shadows to indicate scrollable content overflow with automatic detection of scroll position.

descriptions.cn: 搜索输入字段，包含清除按钮与搜索图标。
descriptions.en: Search input field with clear button and search icon

descriptions.cn: Select 展示可折叠的选项列表，并允许用户从中选择一项。
descriptions.en: A select displays a collapsible list of options and allows a user to select one of them

descriptions.cn: 在内容区块之间进行视觉分隔。
descriptions.en: Visually divide content sections

descriptions.cn: Skeleton 用于展示加载状态，并预览组件的预期形状。
descriptions.en: Skeleton is a placeholder to show a loading state and the expected shape of a component.

descriptions.cn: Slider 允许用户在范围内选择一个或多个值。
descriptions.en: A slider allows a user to select one or more values within a range

descriptions.cn: 用于展示等待或处理中状态的加载指示组件。
descriptions.en: A loading indicator component to show pending states

descriptions.cn: 提供表面级样式与子组件上下文的容器组件。
descriptions.en: Container component that provides surface-level styling and context for child components

descriptions.cn: 用于布尔状态的开关组件。
descriptions.en: A toggle switch component for boolean states

descriptions.cn: 表格以行和列展示结构化数据，支持排序、选择、列宽调整与无限滚动。
descriptions.en: Tables display structured data in rows and columns with support for sorting, selection, column resizing, and infinite scrolling.

descriptions.cn: Tabs 将内容组织为多个区块，并允许用户在它们之间导航。
descriptions.en: Tabs organize content into multiple sections and allow users to navigate between them.

descriptions.cn: 可聚焦的标签列表，支持键盘导航、选择与移除。
descriptions.en: A focusable list of tags with support for keyboard navigation, selection, and removal

descriptions.cn: 原语级多行文本输入组件，可接受标准 HTML 属性。
descriptions.en: Primitive multiline text input component that accepts standard HTML attributes

descriptions.cn: 便于组合的文本字段，包含标签、说明与内联校验。
descriptions.en: Composition-friendly text fields with labels, descriptions, and inline validation

descriptions.cn: 基于 React Aria TimeField 的时间输入字段，包含标签、说明与校验。
descriptions.en: Time input field with labels, descriptions, and validation built on React Aria TimeField

descriptions.cn: 向用户展示临时通知与消息，支持自动消失与可定制的放置位置。
descriptions.en: Display temporary notifications and messages to users with automatic dismissal and customizable placement

descriptions.cn: 用于在开启/关闭或已选中/未选中状态之间切换的交互式切换控件。
descriptions.en: An interactive toggle control for on/off or selected/unselected states

descriptions.cn: 将多个 ToggleButton 组合为统一控件，允许用户选择单个或多个选项。
descriptions.en: Groups multiple ToggleButtons into a unified control, allowing users to select one or multiple options.

descriptions.cn: 用于承载可交互控件的容器，并支持方向键导航。
descriptions.en: A container for interactive controls with arrow key navigation.

descriptions.cn: 当用户悬停或聚焦某个元素时，展示提示性文本。
descriptions.en: Displays informative text when users hover over or focus on an element

descriptions.cn: 面向标题、正文与行内代码的语义化排版原语，基于 React Aria Components 的 Text 构建。
descriptions.en: A semantic typography primitive for headings, body copy, and inline code built on React Aria Components Text.
